summary: Petrobras, via subsidiary Petrobras Global Finance B.V., announced the full redemption of its 5.999% Global Notes due 2028, totaling US$1,080,945,000. The redemption date is September 25, 2026, at a make-whole price equal to the greater of par or discounted remaining payments at Treasury Rate plus 50 basis points, plus accrued interest. Funds come from available cash. The notes and Petrobras guaranty will be cancelled upon redemption. This debt-reduction move reduces leverage; watch for the make-whole amount determination three business days prior to redemption and the note cancellation.
